'''Guardian Squad''' was a unit of [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtroopers]] assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Alongside [[Sentinel Squad]] and [[Protector Squad]], they were tasked with defending [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]] and evacuating him from [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The unit comprised ten desert stormtroopers armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and a single [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].<ref name="Sand" />
